references.text: God declares that he will take the Israelites as his people and be their God, and that they shall know that he is the Lord who brought them out of Egypt.
The introduction to the Ten Commandments where God identifies himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt.
God reminds Israel that he brought them out of Egypt to be their God, and therefore they must be holy.
God grounds his commandments in the fact that he is the Lord who brought them out of Egypt.
God declares that he is the Lord your God who brought you out of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.
God reminds that he is the Lord your God who brought you out of Egypt so that you should not be slaves.
God identifies himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt to be their God.
Repetition of the Ten Commandments where God declares that he brought Israel out of Egypt.
God reminds through Ezekiel of the day he chose Israel and revealed himself to them in Egypt.
The book of Hebrews quotes Jeremiah regarding the new covenant and refers to when God brought the fathers out of Egypt and promised to be their God.
